about: Wine declared by producers (hl) in 2025 for the Portuguese names whose ground the table can be read for, from Statistics Portugal's indicator 0012835 «Produção vinícola declarada em vinho (hl) pelos produtores por Local de vinificação (NUTS - 2024) e Qualidade e cor do vinho» (dados.gov.pt, CC BY 4.0): the PDO wine and PDO fortified wine (or the PGI wine) made in the municipalities, districts or region of the name's demarcated area, as its technical file writes it, where no other name of its kind lies in them. Changed: municipalities summed. Wine is counted where it was made, not where its grapes grew. Built by scripts/kb/fetch-pt-production.ts.
